description: This file is a shell script used for utility tasks such as checking and killing processes, retrieving MAC addresses, and querying DNS internet status on a Raspberry Pi platform within a specific project.

methods.name: checkProcess
methods.description: Checks if a process with a given name is running, returns its process ID(s).

methods.name: killProcess
methods.description: Kills a process with a specified name.

methods.name: getCMMACAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a specific network interface ('erouter0').

methods.name: getQueryResult
methods.description: Initiates a DNS query and retrieves the result status for a specified interface index.

search-terms: shell script for process and network utility
